properties.name: database.type
properties.description: Legacy alias for the WCDK fallback driver/schema hint. The new property wins when both are nonblank. Removal planned for 4.0.0.

properties.name: wcdk.r2dbc.database-type
properties.description: Driver hint for the single-source WCDK fallback and schema initializer; does not override Spring Boot or multi-source URL drivers. Blank values fall back to database.type, then the URL/metadata.

properties.name: wcdk.r2dbc.strict-unused-parameters
properties.description: XML 方法入参未使用时拒绝执行；false 仅用于迁移期间保留历史兼容行为。

properties.name: wcdk.r2dbc.base-packages
properties.description: 显式仓储扫描包；设置后不追加 Spring Boot 自动配置包。

properties.name: wcdk.r2dbc.logic-delete-value
properties.description: 逻辑删除值，按实体列类型转换。

properties.name: wcdk.r2dbc.logic-not-delete-value
properties.description: 未删除值，按实体列类型转换。

properties.name: wcdk.r2dbc.database-initializer.timeout
properties.description: Schema 初始化总阻塞等待上限，必须为正数；超时取消初始化并使启动失败。

properties.name: wcdk.r2dbc.sql-log-complete-enabled
properties.description: 独立完整 SQL 日志开关；同时开启 sql-log-enabled 才生效，敏感值仍脱敏。

properties.name: wcdk.r2dbc.sensitive-columns
properties.description: 敏感参数/列名，默认含 phone/mobile/tel/cardNo/idCard/password/token/secret/credential；关键词和值模式额外生效。
